##### Project general facts

Anwa is the first and tallest tower in its district, featuring dazzling floors with elegant residences and retail units, all offering magnificent views of the Arabian Sea and Dubai. Its unique location and splendid design make it the perfect home where residents can truly relax and enjoy life to a spectacular soundtrack of waves, with an ever-inspiring interplay of sea and sun in absolute tranquility. This iconic development stands as a landmark of sophistication, just a step away from exciting dining, entertainment, and cultural possibilities.

The development is perfectly positioned at the heart of a vibrant waterfront community, connected to exciting and innovative living experiences. Residents are surrounded by some of the most iconic destinations in Dubai, including ocean liner venues, premium beach clubs, and stunningly extravagant resorts within minutes from home. The area offers a perfect balance of laid-back relaxation and action-packed fun, with a vast array of entertainment options for the whole family.

Each residence features marble stone flooring throughout living areas, high-quality paint finishes, and fully finished bathrooms with premium ceramic tiles and designer sanitary ware. The fully fitted European kitchens by a renowned brand include integrated cooking, cooling, and cleaning appliances, ensuring effortless culinary experiences. Durable American timber-look wardrobes and doors, premium ironmongery, and soaring ceiling heights create an atmosphere of refined luxury, with select units featuring impressive double-height living spaces and staff accommodation with natural light.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Dubai Maritime City, a unique and innovative community located in the heart of Dubai that offers a comprehensive range of maritime services and infrastructure. The community is designed to create a conducive environment for businesses and professionals in the maritime sector, featuring state-of-the-art shipyards, dry docks, and repair facilities. The area offers specialized zones for maritime businesses, maritime services, and maritime education and training institutions.

The district is strategically located, offering convenient access to major transportation hubs and business districts throughout Dubai. The community benefits from its proximity to Dubai's ports, connecting it to global trade routes and facilitating seamless movement of goods and services. The strategic location ensures efficient logistics and easy connectivity for businesses and residents alike.

The neighborhood's unique maritime character creates a distinctive and vibrant atmosphere that sets it apart from other areas of Dubai. The community's innovative design and comprehensive infrastructure make it an ideal destination for those seeking a dynamic and well-connected living environment. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of maritime heritage, strategic connectivity, and modern urban living, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most distinctive communities.
